subsystem.name: GenericRuntimeObjects
subsystem.responsibility: Structurally heterogeneous runtime-support helpers reconstructed in the generic_runtime_objects scope: vtable-managed object lifecycle (constructor-style init, vtable re-installation, scalar-deleting destructors gated on a deleting-flag bit), singly-linked containers (front-pop, merge-sort with a 104-entry priority table, indexed filename lookup, fallback string insert), a 560-byte-stride slot array with activation byte and active-slot counter, string/path accessors with a shared default fallback, address-exposing stubs, and thin forwarding/dispatch wrappers. No concrete owning class is established by the packet; class groupings below are structural proposals only.

summary: Reconstruction of the generic_runtime_objects scope: 42 validated functions that act as unowned runtime helpers. Behavior and control flow are well evidenced (confidence HIGH for most functions); ownership and field semantics are not (all packet owners are UnknownObject). The dominant structural families are: (1) vtable-managed lifecycle routines that install or re-install a vtable at object+0 and, in destructors, gate a FreeWrapper_7bcf release on the low bit of a deleting flag; (2) singly-linked-list operations sharing a node layout of payload-at+0 and next-at+4, including a recursive merge sort whose comparator reads a 104-entry priority table; (3) a 560-byte-stride slot array with an activation byte and an active-slot counter at +0xE40C; (4) accessors that return a string-pointer field and fall back to the global empty string; (5) stubs that expose a code or data address as an integer. Class groupings below are GUESS proposals on structural similarity; distinct vtable addresses suggest distinct concrete classes that the packet does not name.

function_roles.role: Cap-gated division helper: computes min(cap, dividend / max(1, divisor_candidate - 1)); dividend comes from delegate 0x00464EE0, divisor candidate and cap are read from the slot-array region. Invoked from the EntityVisibilityGridManager visibility-grid update path.

Tail-call forwarding wrapper: reads the pointer at this+0x0, forwards it together with a2 to the single delegated routine (sub_464D30 in raw source), and returns that routine's value. Called by SessionTypeSetter.

Per-slot activation: computes the activation-byte address as array_base + 560*a2 + 248 (array_base = dword at obj+0), marks the slot active, increments the active-slot count at array_base + 0xE40C; returns the slot pointer when already active, else the container array base. Called by TeamRadioNetworkMessageProcessing.

Slot-indexed float store: computes a storage index as 560*a1 + v3 + 140, converts argument a2 via BufferSizeLookup, and stores the value through FloatStoreWithConversion, returning the store result. Called from NetCommPlayerSlotSync (per-player-slot network sync, inferred from ABI lead name).

Linked-list front pop: writes the head node's payload (node+0) to the caller out-parameter *a2 and advances the head at *this+0xE5C8 to the node's next pointer (node+4); returns 1 on success, 0 when the list is empty or the head payload is zero. Called by InputCommandDispatchToEntities.

Recursive merge sort of a singly-linked list (next pointer at node+4), split at midpoint and merged with a deterministic comparator over a 104-entry priority table at dword_7CD2AC+58384 (top two bits, masked sub-field, low byte with 255 sentinel, table position). Used by EntityVisibilityGridManager for entity ordering.
Address-exposing stub: converts the code pointer of sub_466000 to an integer via BooleanToIntConversion; no state change. Consistent with a callback or registration pattern.
Guarded cleanup of a single global allocation: reads dword_7CD460; when non-null frees it via FreeWrapper_7bcf and returns the wrapper result, otherwise returns zero.
Address-exposing stub: converts the data address unk_466060 to an integer via BooleanToIntConversion; no state change. Mirrors the sibling code-pointer stub.

Thin forwarding wrapper: passes this to StringCopyWithBufferRealloc and returns its result. The deterministic facts also record a read of global dword_7CD468 that the raw source text does not show (source/facts contradiction).
Side-effect-free byte getter: reads and returns the byte at this+0x3C. No callers recorded in the packet.

Angle-ratio computation and store: computes sqrt(this[62]^2 - this[70]^2), stores to this+0x11C; then stores the ratio this[70]/this[62] to this+0x120 through a float-conversion wrapper. Returns 0. Wrappers WrapperReturn0 and FloatConvertWrapper treated as opaque.
Constructor-style init: calls base initializer 0x00466090, installs vtable off_59F668 at this+0x0, writes sentinel -1 at this+0x128; returns the initialized this pointer.
Thin wrapper forwarding the receiver to PlayerProfileScanner (0x00468EE0) with a literal second argument 0; always returns 0. Consistent with a profile-scan invocation during profile page handling.

Indexed filename lookup in a linked list whose head is at this+0x444 and element count at this+0x450 (next pointer at node+4, node+0 points to a string array); copies the resolved string to this+0x344, strips one trailing backslash, returns the buffer. Out-of-range, missing-node, or null-string cases return the shared fallback byte_5EA438.

Destructor-style thiscall: installs vtable off_59F878 at this+0x0, conditionally frees the sub-object at this+0x348 via FreeWrapper_7bcf when non-null, then tail-calls LinkedListDestructor(this) and returns its result.
Conditional release helper: always runs SeasonDatabaseCleanup (0x0046A530), then frees this via FreeWrapper_7bcf when bit 0 of a2 is set; returns this unchanged.

Destructor-style cleanup: resets the vtable at this+0x0 to off_59F938, conditionally frees the sub-object at this+0x174 via FreeWrapper_7bcf when non-null, then returns the result of FunctionCallWrapper_9440(this). Called by ShortComputation_a510.

Sets the vtable pointer at this+0x0 to off_59F9E8, then delegates to FunctionCallWrapper_9440(this) and returns its result. Unconditional partial-cleanup step invoked by DestructorWithConditionalFree_a950 (0x0046A950).
Sequential UI cleanup helper: calls SessionEntryListCleanup (0x0046AE60) then UIListSelectionHandler (0x00489AB0) with arguments 0 and 1 on this; always returns 0.
Unconditional thiscall writing constant 2 into the dword at this+0x174; returns void. Called by sub_4A0250 during setup; treated as a state/counter field initialization.
Stateless global sign test: returns true when the signed global dword_7CD2B8 is negative, else false. No parameters, no callees, no side effects. Called by DriverTableIndexInitialization.

Conditional virtual dispatch gated by a state check: calls sub_4D24A0 (condition reads global dword_8ACEE0); when it returns 0, dispatches vtable slot 56 (offset +0x38) on this with state 1; always dispatches the same slot with state 0 before returning 0. Two-state notification (active then inactive).

Scalar-deleting destructor: invokes the vtable setter VTableSetterSubCall (0x0046D630) on this, then frees the object memory via FreeWrapper_7bcf when deleting flag a2 has bit 0 set; returns this unchanged (MSVC scalar-deleting-destructor convention).

VTable setter installing off_59FC08 at this+0x0, then delegating to an init-with-cleanup subcall and forwarding its return value. Invoked by the scalar-deleting destructor 0x0046D610 as its teardown step.
Scalar-deleting-destructor dispatch helper: unconditionally runs VTableSetInitCall (0x0046D6C0), then frees this via FreeWrapper_7bcf only when a2 bit 0 is set; returns this.

Three-step processing chain: cleans up the global device handle dword_7C73E8 via CleanupWrapper (0x00433EB0), fetches the UI list element at index 0 via UIListIndexedAccessor (0x00487010), sets a path-register field with flag 0x40000000 via PathRegisterFieldSet (0x00498D00); returns 0.

Name-gated object activation: compares input string a2 with the first element of the global string reference array off_5C666C; on match sets the activation flag byte at this+0x174 to 1, invokes the vtable callback at offset 0x2C with (this, 1), returns 1; on mismatch resets the flag to 0 and returns 0 without dispatch.

Thin __thiscall wrapper: reads the vtable at this+0x0, invokes the virtual method at vtable offset 0xA0 (pre-hook), then calls ScreenMenuNavigationController(this) and returns its result. Unconditional.
VTable re-assignment: writes vtable pointer off_5A0308 into this+0x0, then calls VTableSetterSubCall_b4e0() and returns its result. Unconditional; likely a re-initialization or mode switch.

UI toggle increment/decrement handler: reads the toggle value through the pointer stored at this+0x320, adjusts by +1 when a2 == 1 else -1, clamps to [0,1], writes back, then calls EditBufferStringUpdate (0x0048B810) with a 32-byte stack buffer and returns its result.

String-path resolution with fallback: resolves an optional input string into a trimmed token (space scan starting at len-29 when len > 27), inserts the non-empty token via LinkedListInsertWithNodeAllocation (0x00486F30) at position -1; inserts fallback argument a3 when the input is null or resolves to an empty token.

Resource check + virtual notify: retrieves a resource object through the GameCommandDispatchInterface vtable (global dword_7CD8C0, virtual slot 28) with resource ID 19; when non-null compares its name (reading +0xAC) with this via ObjectNameComparison (0x00477280); then unconditionally invokes the virtual method at this-vtable offset 172; returns 0.

Thiscall wrapper: calls VTableSetterWithSubCall (0x00475040) to configure the object, then frees this via FreeWrapper_7bcf when bit 0 of flag a2 is set; always returns this (even when freed). Mirrors the scalar-deleting family with a different setup callee.
Wrapper that calls SeasonDatabaseObjectInitB (0x00475140) to initialize a sub-object, then frees this via FreeWrapper_7bcf when bit 0 of a2 is set; returns this unchanged.
Season database object init variant: installs vtable off_5A4370 into this+0x0, then forwards this to FunctionCallWrapper_9440 for further initialization and returns its result. No guards.

__stdcall helper filling a two-dword output pair from an input position and two range endpoints: when the first dwords of both endpoints are equal the output is hardcoded to (10, 10); otherwise output is (a1, interpolated value) using CRTFtol (0x00587BDC) on the weighted float result. Called by sub_475A90.
Vtable dispatch thunk: loads the vtable at this+0x0, dispatches the method pointer at vtable+0x8 with (this, this+0x14, this+0x18) and returns its result.
Byte-flag setter (__thiscall): unconditionally writes argument a2 into the byte at this+0x2C and returns a2. No guards, no calls, no global access.
Accessor returning a widget name string pointer stored at this+0x40; when null, returns the global default string byte_5EA438.
Accessor returning a load-path string pointer stored at this+0x04; when null, returns the global default string byte_5EA438.
Calls UIDimensionCapture (0x0048EBD0) on this to capture/save UI element dimensions, then clears the byte flag at this+0x17C to 0; always returns 0.

classes.name: VTableManagedObject
classes.responsibility: Structural umbrella (GUESS) for objects whose lifecycle installs a vtable at +0x0 and whose teardown re-installs a vtable and may conditionally release memory via FreeWrapper_7bcf when the deleting-flag bit 0 is set. Observed vtable tables differ (off_59F668, off_59F878, off_59FC08, off_5A0308), so this likely spans several distinct concrete classes the packet does not name.

classes.name: SeasonDatabaseObject
classes.responsibility: Structural umbrella (GUESS) for season-database-style objects: vtable installed at +0x0 (off_59F938 / off_59F9E8 / off_5A4370), a sub-object at +0x174 freed when non-null, and a common tail delegate FunctionCallWrapper_9440. Two thin wrappers (0x0046A510, 0x00475120) pair each cleanup/init variant with a conditional free of the enclosing object.

classes.name: SlotArrayContainer
classes.responsibility: Structural umbrella (GUESS) for functions sharing a 560-byte-stride slot array: container base pointer at +0x0, per-slot activation byte at element+248, active-slot count dword at base+0xE40C, and slot-indexed arithmetic (560*a1+140). Owner object and the exact array are not identified by the packet.

classes.name: SinglyLinkedContainer
classes.responsibility: Structural umbrella (GUESS) for functions operating on singly-linked nodes (payload at node+0, next at node+4) whose head lives in the containing object. Observed heads: list at *obj+0xE5C8 (front-pop) and filename list at this+0x444 with count at this+0x450; the merge-sort takes the head as an argument. The 104-entry priority table (dword_7CD2AC+58384) drives sort order.

classes.name: ActivationFlagObject
classes.responsibility: Structural umbrella (GUESS) for functions sharing the state/activation field at this+0x174: name-matching activation (byte flag 0/1 plus vtable callback at slot 0x2C) and a setup that writes the dword 2. The byte-flag versus dword-2 semantic conflict at +0x174 is unresolved; these may be distinct classes.

classes.name: AddressExposingStub
classes.responsibility: Stubs (GUESS) that expose a code or data address as an integer through BooleanToIntConversion (0x00587B3E) with no state change, consistent with callback registration or address comparison.

classes.name: DefaultedStringAccessor
classes.responsibility: Accessors (GUESS) returning a string-pointer field of the receiver and falling back to the global default string byte_5EA438 when null.

classes.name: VtableDispatchShim
classes.responsibility: Thin __thiscall shims (GUESS) that dispatch through a vtable slot with receiver-forwarded arguments and return the call result.

state_machines.name: ObjectNameMatchingActivation
transitions: name_match (strcmp(off_5C666C[0], a2) == 0) -> active: set flag byte at this+0x174 to 1, dispatch vtable slot 0x2C with (this, 1), return 1
name_mismatch -> inactive: clear flag byte at this+0x174 to 0, return 0

state_machines.name: ConditionalTwoStateNotification
transitions: condition_not_met (sub_4D24A0() == 0) -> dispatch vtable slot 56 (offset +0x38) with state 1
unconditional -> dispatch vtable slot 56 (offset +0x38) with state 0, return 0

state_machines.name: BooleanToggle
transitions: a2 == 1 -> value incremented by 1 and clamped to 1 (upper bound)
a2 != 1 -> value decremented by 1 and clamped to 0 (lower bound)

interfaces.name: GameCommandDispatch
interfaces.purpose: Global interface vtable (dword_7CD8C0) whose virtual slot 28 retrieves a resource/object instance by ID (observed ID 19); the consumer then runs a guarded name comparison (ObjectNameComparison) and notifies through its own vtable slot 172.

interfaces.name: MemoryReleaseWrapper
interfaces.purpose: Uniform release point (FreeWrapper_7bcf) used by the guarded free of a global buffer and by every scalar-deleting/conditional-free destructor in this scope; the release is gated on the MSVC deleting-flag bit 0.

interfaces.name: IntAddressExposer
interfaces.purpose: BooleanToIntConversion (0x00587B3E) converts a code or data address into an integer for callback registration or comparison; the stubs produce no side effects.

compatibility_contracts.name: ScalarDeletingDestructorConvention
compatibility_contracts.description: Destructor-family functions in this scope take a deleting flag in a2: when bit 0 is set the object memory is released through FreeWrapper_7bcf, otherwise the object is kept; the function returns the this pointer in both cases (MSVC scalar-deleting-destructor convention). A replacement must preserve this flag gating and the returned-pointer semantics.

compatibility_contracts.name: VtablePointerAtObjectOffsetZero
compatibility_contracts.description: Objects in this scope keep their active vtable pointer at byte offset 0x0; constructor/init and teardown routines install or re-install vtables there. Observed tables: off_59F668, off_59F878, off_59F938, off_59F9E8, off_59FC08, off_5A0308, off_5A4370.

compatibility_contracts.name: SinglyLinkedNodeLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: List nodes carry a payload pointer at node+0 and the next-node pointer at node+4; a zero payload is treated as invalid (front pop returns failure) and a null next terminates the list. List heads are stored in the containing object (observed at *obj+0xE5C8 and this+0x444, with count at this+0x450).

unresolved: Concrete owning classes of all 42 functions are unproven; the packet leaves every owner UnknownObject. Class groupings (VTableManagedObject, SeasonDatabaseObject, SlotArrayContainer, SinglyLinkedContainer, ActivationFlagObject, AddressExposingStub, DefaultedStringAccessor, VtableDispatchShim) are GUESS proposals on structural similarity and must be verified before reuse.

The distinct vtable addresses (off_59F668, off_59F878, off_59F938, off_59F9E8, off_59FC08, off_5A0308, off_5A4370) most likely indicate distinct concrete classes, not one class; the packet does not connect any vtable to a type name.

Field this+0x174 is read with conflicting semantics: SeasonDatabaseCleanup frees it as a sub-object pointer, while SetField174ToTwo writes the dword 2 and ObjectNameMatchingActivation uses it as a 0/1 activation byte. This may be two classes or a union at one offset; unresolved.

The 560-byte-stride slot array's owning object, the semantic roles of the a2 index and the divisor/cap fields, and the source/facts R-W classification contradiction on the +0xE40C counter and the activation byte in 0x004652D0 are unresolved.

Delegates named only in the raw source with no packet callee entry cannot be resolved: sub_464D30 (0x00465150), LinkedListDestructor (0x0046A270), FunctionCallWrapper_9440 (0x0046A530/0x0046A970/0x00475140), InitWithVTableCleanup (0x0046D630), ScreenMenuNavigationController (0x00470170), VTableSetterSubCall_b4e0 (0x004702F0).

The read of global dword_7CD468 recorded for 0x00466080 is absent from the raw source text; a deterministic-facts versus raw-source contradiction (the material ref is carried in unresolved_evidence_refs).
Priority-table values at dword_7CD2AC+58384 and how the packed-key fields (top two bits, masked sub-field, low byte with 255 sentinel) map to visual sort order are not derivable from this packet.
The base pointer v3 in 0x00464F50 is uninitialized in the decompiled view; the reads at +58380 and +684+560*a2 cannot be attributed to a verified object.
The vtable-slot offsets 0x8, 0x2C, 0x38, 0xA0, 0xA0/0xAC and slot-172 dispatch targets are resolved only as offsets; the callback identities are unknown.
